findings.failure_path: the Wait Policy drops the concrete lane-budget numbers (2400s default, 5-3600 range, 10 reserved controller seconds, 21s/16s fail-closed minimums) for a pointer asserting references/timeout-auth-and-capabilities.md already carries them, but that file is outside the bounded packet and no visible suite assertion pins the numbers there, so absence or drift in the target would silently strip the fail-closed limits from the entrypoint with no test failing
findings.smallest_fix: add a suite pin asserting those numbers appear in references/timeout-auth-and-capabilities.md (or include the target section in the review packet)

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: The recurrence trigger fires exactly when the current round is findings and carried history already holds one: in-chain priors are counted via status=="findings" in the tracked-chain loop, the succession carry adds the predecessor receipt's own verdict, and claim_strength is added to build and release STAGE_CONCERNS with plan coverage enforced pre-provider; the relocated wording-only specification is verbatim under new headers and the contract's pointer to it is asserted.

The change is additive gate metadata: one required-trigger value and one allowed-action value appended only on the findings path; it blocks nothing findings_returned does not already block, grants no authority, touches no credential or egress surface, and missing or older receipts fail safe through .get("status").

A missing, passed, or inconclusive predecessor leaves the count at in-chain rounds; succession does not compose so a third chain opened fresh counts nothing; a plan omitting claim_strength exits rc=2 with self_review_incomplete before any client state exists, i.e. fails closed rather than reaching a reviewer.

Each new predicate has a positive probe (in-chain recurrence, cross-succession recurrence, plan-coverage rejection) and a paired negative control leg asserting a first findings round does not raise the trigger; the applied-mutation RED claims (274 ok/0 FAIL control, each mutant failing exactly its owning assertion) are consistent with the assertions shipped, and all shifted concern-index expectations (build 5, release 8, wording-only 6/8) are coherent with the inserted concern.

The envelope gains new members in existing arrays rather than new shapes; the one caller-breaking change (claim_strength now required in self-review plans) fails closed with a clear reason_code and all in-repo fixtures were updated in the same commit; however the Wait Policy pointer that replaced the concrete budget numbers rests on a target file outside the packet with no visible pin, recorded as the finding below.

Change is local to the repository's controller and documents; new profile, succession, and result fields are additive so previously minted receipts remain readable, and reverting the commit restores prior behavior with no migration or persisted state to unwind.

The trigger and its allowed action surface in the round's own result envelope where the chain agent already reads, and SKILL.md now requires the final work summary to record the keep/delete/narrow/replace decision, what it recurred across, and who ratified it.

The counting claim is explicitly bounded to what a receipt carries (this chain plus the one named predecessor, no composition) and the RED claims name exact assertions and control counts; the one claim the packet cannot carry is that the removed budget numbers already live in references/timeout-auth-and-capabilities.md, reported as the finding.

The shared-gate edit removes or narrows no controller-required concern, leaves challenge-budget and wording-only proof semantics untouched, keeps the wording-only specification pinned by the extraction suite at its new location, and asserts no waiver or completion authority.
